desc: This Kimber Magazine is a standard factory replacement magazine. It is designed for use in Kimber R7 Mako pistols chambered in 9mm Luger and the magazine holds 13 rounds of ammunition. It is made from high-quality steel with a polymer follower, a high-quality spring, and a durable coating. Additionally, it is worth noting that the magazine is made to Kimber's specifications and tolerances, using the same manufacturing process and materials as the original equipment magazines that shipped with your firearm. This will ensure not only a perfect fit but exceptional operation.
